remarks: Luxury living awaits in downtown condo building. This newer property features 2 spacious bedrooms, 2 baths, and an open floor plan. The kitchen is equipped with GE stainless appliances, granite counters, dishwasher, disposal, washer/dryer and a large island. The unit is bright, with a natural courtyard facing setting. The primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet, en-suite bath (primary), and deck access. Guest bedroom also include walk in closet and separate full bath. Amenities include a fitness center, club room, terrace with grills, and a shuttle service. Reserved parking and a guest pass are provided. Make your appointment today, will go fast.  Pictures are from prior listing. This unit is unfurnished.
